newsitem.title: USA: GumTech to sell products in eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: GumTech to sell products in eastern Europe.

text.p: GumTech International Inc said it has received one $100,000 order for several of its products scheduled to be distributed in Eastern Europe.

"This marks another significant step for GumTech in that both the geographic area and the idea of multilevel marketing offer enormous potential for our products," Jerry Kern, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

The order is from Leomar International Inc, of Santa Monica, Calif. It will be shipped in early to mid-January. Products include Ginseng Gum, Digestive Gum, Buzz (Guarana) Gum, PMS Gum, DentaHealth and diet product, Chromatrim.
